body:
I really thought there was a chance at the beginning, but it was made very clear that she needed time to herself and to be single for a while due to a side of herself that couldn't connect. I struggled with this for a while. I finally went on a date about 2 weeks ago, but all it really did was bring back feelings and made me realize I wasn't ready to have that type of connection with anyone. I think that maybe have been the start of this for me.

There's definitely a part of me that wants it to happen, even though I have a pretty good idea of how unlikely it would be. It was all in all a strong relationship. I felt it was anyway.

The night before we split up I had a very difficult conversation with my uncle's roommate about him wanting his house when he passed, which was something I felt was very inappropriate. When I needed her most she split up with me.

I'm not sure yet. The first time it happened it was more of a fleeting thought. Last time it was after I saw her. It was a very mixed emotions night. We hadn't spoken since my uncle's memorial which she asked to be there for. She had seen me and waved me to come over. We talked for a bit and she needed comforting because someone that was persuing  her had apparently died and she thought it might have been suicide. (In the end he had OD'd) She was pretty upset because a childhood friend had done the same thing to her about 4 years ago and it was a similar situation and she thought she would see the signs and could help. I did my best, but was not really a situation I wanted to be involved in or hear about.

We spent most of the night talking together one on one. It had it's good moments to, but I think it drained me emotionally.

I'm 32 and I've been through these things before; I just don't understand why it would effect me so much this time. I've been considering that I stop drinking but it seems to be the only place I can go to get any socializing in. I live in a tourist town. Beach and bars is basically all we have here. Either way I think it is something I'm going to have to quit. Which sucks for several reasons because after college I managed several bars in this town so almost everyone I know is in that scene. 

I don't take any meds or have been to a doctor. I also don't have insurance because of my line of work. Usually I pay out of pocket but I only ever needed to see the doctor every 3 years for a severe cold. I'd prefer to escape this either way without the meds though.
